sources.title: Order Cancellation Policy
sources.snippet:
Order Cancellation Policy
Orders may be cancelled free of charge before they are handed over to the courier.

draft_body: Orders can be cancelled free of charge only before they are handed over to the courier [S1]. Since your order is currently in the shipping process, we are unable to cancel it.
